summary: Revenue Engine Frontend P1 tested. All 16 frontend features verified. Revenue Dashboard loads with KPI cards, date/status filters, 3-way aggregation tables, and revenue records table. Pipeline page shows 5 primary columns (Applied, Shortlisted, Interview, Offered, Joined). 'Move to Offered' and 'Move to Joined' buttons visible and functional with proper dialogs. Dialogs collect correct inputs (offered_ctc, offer_date, join_date) and show revenue lock warning for join. Revenue sidebar link visible and navigable for admin. Two business-expected behaviors noted: candidates without company commercial config get expected 400 error; candidates in Offered stage without offered_ctc cannot move to Joined (proper validation).
critical_code_review_comments: RevenueDashboardPage.jsx: Clean implementation with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
AdminPipelinePage.jsx: Properly implements offer/join dialogs with validation and revenue lock warning
Revenue sidebar link correctly positioned in admin navigation with IndianRupee icon
api.js: revenueAPI properly exports all revenue endpoints (forecast, offered, joined, records, aggregates)
Offer dialog shows CTC in LPA format and validates required fields before submission
Join dialog displays offered_ctc from application and shows revenue lock warning in red text

success_rate.backend: Not tested (frontend only request, backend already tested in iteration_69)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Revenue Engine Frontend fully implemented. /admin/revenue page loads with date filters (default: last 3 months), status filter (All/Offered/Joined), 4 KPI cards, 3 aggregation tables (company/job/recruiter), and revenue records table. Pipeline page has 5 primary columns with revenue action buttons. Current test data: 1 candidate in Interview stage, 2 candidates in Offered stage (but without offered_ctc because they were moved there without using revenue flow). To generate revenue records, need to: 1) Have a candidate in Interview stage with a company that has commercial config, 2) Click 'Move to Offered' with CTC and date, 3) Then click 'Move to Joined' with join date.

business_expected_behaviors.Company without commercial config: Returns 400 error with 'Company has no commercial configured' - This is expected per revenue engine design
business_expected_behaviors.Offered candidates without offered_ctc c: Returns 400 error with 'Cannot move to joined: offered_ctc is not set' - Proper validation

notes: No revenue records currently exist because existing offered candidates were moved there via regular stage transition (without using revenue/offered endpoint). To test full flow, need a candidate in Interview stage whose job is for a company with commercial config (like Volvo Commercial Vehicle with 8.33%).
